Name: DHG's Sichuancuisine
Author: hellofay
Description:
20260515更新：
又新增了一些菜谱，狼牙土豆什么的，还是小吃（不忘初心），还有作者本人喜欢的熊猫；
并更换了奶黄包和两个肉夹馍的贴图（奶黄包因为流心被强迫症朋友说受不了，肉夹馍被吐槽长得不像肉夹馍）。
Several new recipes have been added, including Wolf Tooth Potato and other snacks, as well as the author's favorite panda-themed dishes.
The sprites for Custard Bun and the two Roujiamo have been replaced.

新增了4种香料，其中花椒、青花椒和椒蒿在沙漠商店可以买到，折耳根在猪车出售。
折耳根有两个食谱，暂时还只是普通的食物。
Four new spices have been added. Among them, Huajiao (Sichuan peppercorn), Green Huajiao, and Jiaohao can be purchased at Sandy's shop in the Desert, while Houttuynia (fish mint / heartleaf) is sold by the Traveling Merchant.
Houttuynia has two recipes, for now they are just ordinary food items.


20260512更新：
新增了天府可乐、烤苕皮等16道菜谱，更换了包子的贴图；
Added 16 recipes including TianfuCola and GrilledSweetPotatoSlice, and changed the image of Baozi；
食物依然天南海北，主要是想到什么画什么。
The food still comes from all over the place , mainly because I just draw whatever comes to mind.



大家好，关于我想在星露谷里整点烟火气这件事，我做了30+ 道中式家常 & 街头小吃。
一开始的本意是做一个川菜包，所以名字也叫川菜包，但是做着做着思维开始发散，
是的，所以你们会看到一些不是川菜的菜也放进来了
——没有硬说它们都是川菜的意思，而是作者本人做事木有计划——
好啦，希望你们能喜欢，祝用餐愉快。
Hi everyone, so about me wanting to bring some lively, wok-hei flavors to Stardew Valley… I ended up making over 30 Chinese home-style dishes and street snacks. My original plan was to make a Sichuan cuisine pack – hence the name. But as I went along, my train of thought started wandering… and yes, that’s why you’ll see some dishes that aren’t strictly Sichuanese. I’m not trying to pass them all off as Sichuan food – it’s just that the author has zero planning skills. Anyway, I hope you enjoy them, and happy eating!

本MOD没有新增作物，一些食谱的制作要基于豆腐——一个青豆制作，
然后加点鱼虾做肉丸，荤菜就是这么来的，
至于用豆腐鱼虾做出了火腿，这是星露谷炼金术，大家就不要深究了。
This mod does not add any new crops. Some recipes require making tofu first — which is made from green beans — and then adding fish and shrimp to make meatballs. That's how the meat dishes come about. As for how tofu, fish, and shrimp can be turned into ham slices... that's just Stardew Valley alchemy, so don't overthink it.

对了贴图是32x32像素的。
By the way, the sprites are 32x32 pixels.
